title: A field's own bddo:bitOrder takes precedence over the struct's
description: The struct declares LSBFirst; field a declares MSBFirst and takes the top three bits of 0xB4 (101 = 5). Field b, back under the struct's LSBFirst, differs in order from a, so it begins on the next byte and takes the low five bits of 0x16 (10110 = 22).
